title: Orphaned runtime routes — quick inventory
summary: One-off inventory of low-usage / unowned runtime routes observed by traffic sampling on 2029-03-12. Aim: identify candidates for deprecation, consolidation, or reassignment. Quick risk and cost estimate included.
body:
columns: route_id | product_area | current_owner | last_seen (UTC) | avg_rps_7d | peak_rps_7d | approx_monthly_tokens | last_deploy_tag | suggested_action | risk_level | quick_notes

--- quick totals (rough estimates):
tracked_routes: 20
routes_with_no_owner: 9
approx_total_monthly_tokens: ~6.3M
approx_total_monthly_cost_estimate: ~$650 (very rough, token-based avg)

--- quick risk pick list (why rows chosen):
- ROW_003, ROW_008, ROW_016 -> zero/near-zero usage and stale deploy tag -> safe deprecate candidates
- ROW_005, ROW_011, ROW_014, ROW_018 -> internal/no-SLA routes that should be ACL'd or monitored
- ROW_013, ROW_006, ROW_002 -> active but flagged for migration/consolidation

--- suggested immediate next steps (short):
1) Assign owners for rows flagged "unknown" (ping list below). owner assignment due: 2029-03-22.
2) For zero-usage rows, create a 2-week tombstone + no-traffic check, then remove after confirmation.
3) For partner-facing legacy routes, open consolidation tickets with integrations lead (include traffic samples).
4) Add low-volume external routes to monthly "orphan-route" watchlist with 1 alert if growth > 30% week-over-week.

--- ping list / quick slack templates:
- @infra (Evan Li) – please confirm infra deps for ROW_016 and ROW_003: JIRA-OPS-4123

--- raw notes / provenance:
- inventory compiled by sampling route logs (sample windows: 2029-03-09 through 2029-03-12) and cross-referencing deploy tags in routing-config repo.
- cost estimate uses avg token cost $0.0001 per token; counts include embeddings+generation where applicable.
- this is intentionally lightweight - follow-ups: create PRs in routing-config to add owner metadata, and a Confluence page for long-term tracking.
